versions.name: Camp Pine Ridge
versions.summary: A Greater Saint Louis Area Council camp in the Shawnee National Forest on the shores of Little Grassy Lake near Makanda, Illinois, surrounded by the Crab Orchard National Wildlife Refuge, with tent campsites, cabins, a dining hall, and waterfront and climbing activities for year-round unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council and operating status re-verified from the Greater Saint Louis Area Council property page. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
